title: State-slot bit in a chunk
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $v$ be a cell value, and let $t$ be a natural number less than the number of possible state-summary pairs. The bit of the chunk encoding of $v$ at position $t$ is true exactly when the optional state-summary pair recorded in $v$ has numerical code $t$.
